dogecoin.text: @Its_My_Purpose @Newegg @dogecoin Also, I’m not saying it’s worthless. Memes have value. I’m simply saying that $50 billion seems excessive and there are good reasons (historical, logical, and common sense based) to conclude it will likely be fleeting.

@Its_My_Purpose @Newegg @dogecoin Three reasons to start with: Issuance policy, concentration of coins in few wallets, network security. You don’t honestly believe people are buying it to use as a means of payment on Newegg, do you? And I’m skeptical they have any good reason to accept it. Hype and marketing.

@Newegg @dogecoin I get capitalizing on hype as a marketing ploy, but clueless shilling of a dead-end crypto does real harm to folks who buy it at today's outrageous levels (let alone #DogeDay). Why you'd want to be partly responsible for that is beyond comprehension. (I used to be a customer.)

@Archeious @Its_My_Purpose @Newegg @dogecoin Interesting you say that because I'm certainly not a 'hater', either a couple years ago or now. But it sounds like you see relevant similarities between the two. Is that right? What are they in your mind (excluding the obvious price rise)?
